_comment: Synthetic iGOT-style catalogue used by MockKarmayogiClient. Titles are representative of MoSPI/NSSTA capacity-building offerings; identifiers follow the Sunbird do_<digits> convention. Sandbox seed data, not a copy of the live iGOT catalogue.

content.name: Foundations of Survey Design for Official Statistics
content.description: Sampling frames, probability sampling designs, stratification and estimation of sampling error for large-scale official surveys.

content.name: Advanced Sampling Methodology for National Surveys
content.description: Multi-stage stratified designs, PPS sampling, weighting and variance estimation as practised in NSS rounds.

content.name: Questionnaire Design and CAPI Field Operations
content.description: Instrument design, question wording, translation protocols and CAPI/CATI deployment for field enumeration.

content.name: Field Enumeration Practices and Respondent Engagement
content.description: Enumerator protocols, non-response handling and respondent communication for household and enterprise surveys.

content.name: Data Quality Assurance, Editing and Imputation
content.description: Validation rules, consistency edits, outlier detection and imputation strategies for survey microdata.

content.name: Microdata Cleaning Workflows in R and Python
content.description: Reproducible cleaning pipelines, edit rules as code, and automated quality reports using tidyverse and pandas.

content.name: Descriptive and Inferential Statistics for Officers
content.description: Summary measures, sampling distributions, confidence intervals and hypothesis testing applied to official data.

content.name: Applied Regression and Statistical Inference
content.description: Linear and logistic regression, model diagnostics and inference from complex survey samples.

content.name: National Accounts Statistics: GDP and GVA Compilation
content.description: SNA 2008 concepts, production and expenditure approaches, and the compilation of GVA by economic activity.

content.name: Price Statistics and Index Number Theory (CPI/WPI)
content.description: Index formulae, base revision, weighting diagrams and price collection quality control.

content.name: SDG Indicators and the National Indicator Framework
content.description: Global and national indicator frameworks, data sources, tiering and progress reporting for the SDGs.

content.name: SDG Monitoring: From Indicators to Policy Briefs
content.description: Turning indicator movements into evidence for policy, with reporting templates and visual summaries.

content.name: Economic Classification Standards: NIC and NCO
content.description: Applying the National Industrial Classification and National Classification of Occupations in survey coding.

content.name: Coding Practice Lab: NIC/NCO for Field Investigators
content.description: Hands-on coding of enterprise activity and occupation descriptions, with common error patterns.

content.name: Introduction to Statistical Computing for Official Statistics
content.description: First steps in R and Python for officers: data types, importing official datasets, tabulation and simple charts.

content.name: Statistical Computing with R for Official Statistics
content.description: Data manipulation, survey package weighting, reproducible scripts and reporting in R.

content.name: Python for Data Analysis in the Statistical System
content.description: pandas, numpy and statsmodels for official data workflows, from ingestion to publication tables.

content.name: Data Visualization and Statistical Reporting
content.description: Chart selection, dashboard design and accessible tabulation standards for statistical releases.

content.name: Data Ethics, Confidentiality and the Collection of Statistics Act
content.description: Legal obligations, statistical confidentiality, disclosure control and ethical handling of respondent data.

content.name: Statistical Disclosure Control and Safe Data Release
content.description: Anonymisation, k-anonymity, perturbation and safe dissemination of microdata to researchers.

content.name: Big Data and Alternative Data Sources for Official Statistics
content.description: Administrative registers, scanner data, mobile and satellite sources; quality frameworks for non-survey data.

content.name: GIS and Geospatial Statistics for Survey Operations
content.description: Geo-referencing of sampling units, digital listing, and spatial presentation of statistical indicators.

content.name: Geospatial Analysis and Mapping with Open Tools
content.description: QGIS and Python geospatial stacks for district-level statistical mapping and area frames.

content.name: Metadata and Dissemination Standards (SDMX)
content.description: SDMX information model, data structure definitions, code lists and machine-readable dissemination.

content.name: Analytical Thinking and Communicating Statistical Results
content.description: Structuring analysis, writing for decision-makers and presenting uncertainty honestly.

content.name: Evidence to Action: Briefing Senior Officers with Data
content.description: Narrative construction, visual summaries and question handling for statistical briefings.
